title: A user says the v3 to v4 upgrade deleted their network setup
summary: A widely seen complaint says SSH and Tailscale were gone after the upgrade and that the migration never finished.

topics.angle: The cost side of fast, agent-built software.
What an upgrade has to get right before 4.6.

claims.text: The upgrade removed SSH and Tailscale without warning and did not finish.
The post had 2,438 likes and about 309,000 views when read.

to_find: Whether agent-written code caused it: the post does not show that
would_change: A reproduction, a fix, or the user’s follow-up.
